note: Slow-onset fever late in a Mars transit. Every value is a demo parameter chosen by the team, not a medical reference. This file and the expectations below were committed before the evaluation was first run. If any value is changed after seeing results, say so on the project page.
expected: Earth range only: amber on most days of the healthy period, because the in-flight base of 37.4 °C sits above the Earth upper limit. These are false alerts.
Adjusted range: no false alerts in the healthy period. First amber about five days after onset, once the reading passes the adjusted upper limit.
Adjusted range and baseline: no false alerts in the healthy period. First amber earlier than the adjusted range alone, after three readings in a row leave the personal baseline.
All three methods: red on the same day, because the critical limit is fixed and nothing moves it.
